summary: The bulletin board, the centre's home at board depth. New workbench/board_model.py (no Qt): one desk reading with its answers kept (BoardReader, through field_source.read_field), the focus's recorded neighbours one and two links away (reviewed from a source page, the cells a calculation used, evidence and checks of findings, a calculation worked again, an open question and the sources its investigation reads, totals, goal/rule/word links, a plain file with the same bytes as an admitted source, a link kept by your word) and possible ones labelled "not verified" (same words or quantities, the same component, used together in one of your assignments, two revisions by their names); the basis of every link in sentences ("Used values 12 V (cell B2, Rail voltage) and 300 mA (cell B3, Settled current) from Rail Demo bench readings, version 2 (revision ...), to calculate Rail Demo settled power."); sizes through workbench.relevance.rank when present (guarded import; relevance's own vocabulary and order), else a default of four sizes; rings laid out deterministically. Kernel ops board.read, board.links (reads) and board.keep (approve, always asks: the owner's word keeps a possible link as recorded, or sets it aside). New workbench/board_qt.py: the board inside the Field's page (the Field is the whole-desk map, reached by zooming out or "Whole desk"; "Board" on the Field comes back), tiles with kind glyph, KIND • STATE and its mark, title, basis line and source, solid recorded and dashed possible wires with round ends, rings and the axis, a compact wire inspector (Keep this link / Set your word aside / Focus the other end), right-click with Why am I shown?, Pin, Turn down (hidden when relevance is absent). One click focuses through L1's controller (the tree reveals it, Back returns); double click / Enter opens through the existing open route. At launch the board is the centre's home.

decisions: The board shares the Field's page (field_page.FieldPage) instead of a new centre page: the page shows the board or the Field (the whole-desk map). So every caller of host.field_page.view (her column's "this", desk acts, desk_doers, shell2) keeps working: the Field's selection is kept on the board's focus. The Field's acts (Do, Doubt, Trace, Brief, a what-if, two revisions) are drawn on the Field, so asking one while the board is in front shows the Field.

F9 / Arrange > Field / "field" still show the Field (the whole desk) as in 0.8.x, so existing Field tests stay true; navigation by focus (tree, Search, a tile, Back to a board entry, the breadcrumb) shows the board; at launch open_on_work shows the board on the desk's first object.

One desk reading serves both: the page's refresh (wrapped by board_qt.attach) reads the work face with board_model.BoardReader (field_source.read_field gained an optional reader=), which keeps the Kernel answers the basis sentences are read from; moving the focus reads nothing again except board.links, objects.get for same-bytes digests and the owner's assignments.

Inferred "used together" means: named among the inputs of one of the owner's assignments (1.0 K1) with nothing recorded between the two. Two objects that feed one record are already recorded two links apart, so that is not a possible link.

Rev A / Rev B: the sheets are separate records, so their link to each other is a possible one ("two revisions by their names", not verified); a sheet whose title carries ARCHIVED (or SUPERSEDED, OLD) is shown SHEET • ARCHIVED, the owner's own word in the title. A calculation worked again is a recorded revision; its earlier page is drawn as CALC • REPLACED.

An inferred link becomes recorded only by board.keep: approve scope (her read-only principal is refused), named in stacy_hand.ALWAYS_ASKS, pressed by the owner in the inspector. Its record keeps what was suggested; Set your word aside makes it possible again; nothing is deleted (the history is kept).
Cross-references (library.links) join places inside one admitted file, so they give no link between two board tiles; none are drawn (relevance's cross_ref is never sent).

Layout: the recorded neighbours (size 2 and up) on the inner ring, the possible ones on the next; what feeds the focus at the left, what rests on it at the right, possible links above and below, two-step tiles beside their bridge. The board is fitted whole down to 74 % and scrolls (drag, wheel) below that, so the words stay readable at 1366x768; zooming out past 50 % (Ctrl+wheel, minus, Z, or "Whole desk") shows the Field.

Relevance (L3, merged while I built): candidates carry relevance's vocabulary ("candidate <relation> focus": input, output, quoted_by, quotes, finding_on, question_on, revision_of, recorded for two steps away or same bytes / kept, inferred), revision_current, basis, title, stale and words; its size 1..4, place (order), group, reasons, separate marks and more_words are used; Unpin / Turn up again call relevance.clear. The focus is drawn larger than a size-4 neighbour.
findings_for_the_coordinator: Merge: L3's relevance.py is on main and not in my tree; my import is guarded and the smoke exercised it on the throwaway copy (7/7). Regenerate docs/GRAPHITE_0.1_REGISTRY.json at merge (mine adds board.read, board.links, board.keep).

Rail Demo's build is not always the same: in some builds the investigation path of "Startup is inside the Rev B limit of 40 ms." carries its CHECK step and in others not (the Field then has no sheet->finding wire). The board adds the investigation's own list of checks (investigation.sheet "checked") so the wire is there either way; the Field (field_source) still varies.

At launch the board needs the detail reads, and the launch's reading (open_on_work's read_field) is made with a plain Reader, so the board reads the desk once more at launch (one extra Kernel reading). F2 (the floor) may want open_on_work to read with board_model.read_desk.
Window checks (tools/check_*_ui.py, not run by the rule) that expect the Field in front right after launch with restore=True will now see the board; F9 still gives the Field.

P1 (her column) can show the board's focus as "this" through host.field_page.view.selected() (kept in step) or host.field_page.board.focus_obj(); board.read gives the board as data for her or for staC.
L4: double click / Enter on a tile call the existing open route (field_page.open_object via FieldView.opened), so L1's board_opened still tags the tab; the Field's single click still opens there.
not_done: Nothing was tested in the owner's sense and nothing ran on the ThinkPad; Day look frames (P2 not landed).
No source-to-source revision links (crossrefs.earlier_item, the same file name admitted again): not read on the board.
Tiles do not animate between focuses (static, as the Field).
At 1366x768 the outer ring is partly out of view at the least auto size; it scrolls.
release_note: The bulletin board: choose anything in the tree and it sits in the middle of the centre with what is linked to it around it: its sources, the sheets, the calculations and findings with their state words. Solid wires are what the records say; dashed ones are only possible and say "not verified" until you keep them by your word. Click a wire to read its basis ("Used 300 mA from Rail Demo bench readings, version 2, to calculate settled power"). Zoom out for the whole desk.
